periods.time: Immediately after the first Caldia clash is halted

name.zh: 法米利昂与奎多兰代表战正式化
name.en: Formalization of the Vermillion-Quedland Representative War

periods.location: Sky over Caldia battlefield and Vermillion palace
periods.summary: Lunaeyes returns with Or-Gaule and puppet king John, announcing that Vermillion accepts Quedland's declaration under League treaty rules: each nation will choose five mage-knights and decide the war by representative battle. Or-Gaule uses John as a mouthpiece and admits the framework also keeps the League's army away. Nene agrees to support the compromise only because Or-Gaule's side holds Quedland citizens hostage, and Or-Gaule withdraws Naseem and Ein while releasing Lunaeyes.
periods.cause: Lunaeyes's negotiation and Or-Gaule's wish to avoid League interference overlap, though Nene suspects Lunaeyes paid a hidden price beyond ordinary advantage.
periods.process: Stella challenges the claim, Lunaeyes explains the civilian-protection logic, Naseem threatens Or-Gaule for interrupting his fun, Or-Gaule permits League members already in Vermillion to join, and Nene accepts the legal fiction to protect civilians.
periods.outcome: Open fighting stops; wounded soldiers are treated; the war becomes a five-person battle royale in Quedland's capital with Stella required to participate.
periods.significance: Moves the arc from battlefield chaos into a scheduled high-stakes representative war while introducing the mystery of Lunaeyes's 'devil's coin'.
